the following issues: - Modeling of the Virtual Power Plant (VPP) and Demand Response (DR) business cases - Identification of ICT tools and communication infrastructure requirements for the VPP and DR cases - Definition of the VPP and the DR business models - Definition of the architecture of the VPP/DR cases - Definition of a common information model for the VPP/ DR cases - Identification of the most relevant standards and technologies - Identification of the pilot projects in which the proposed architecture will be materialized
